Retinol-binding protein (RBP4)
RBP (gene name RBP4) is the major transporter of retinol in plasma. RBP is a 21-kDa protein of the lipocalin family, it is synthesized
mostly in the liver (see later). It is ﬁltered from plasma in the renal glomerulus, and recovered to a signiﬁcant extent by binding to
a multi-ligand receptor, megalin, which facilitates reuptake. Each RBP molecule binds noncovalently with a single molecule of all-
